id.description: The robot, and what every robot-scoped route takes as its `:id`.

name.description: The robot's display name, at most 63 characters. Free text, changed through `PATCH /api/robots/:id`.

created_at.description: When the robot was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

bridge_state.description: The built-in `bridge_state` datapoint as the cloud observes it right now: whether the bridge is connected, and its latency when it is.

published_version.description: The published configuration version, or `null` when nothing has been published yet. A robot with nothing published is still listed — "not configured yet" is a real state, and the caller is entitled to it — and its datasheet answers an empty exposure list.
